hints.content:
The notation $h(1)$ refers to the output of the function when the input is $x=1$. If the point $(1,b)$ is on the graph, then $h(1)=b$.

We should look for the point on the graph whose $x$-coordinate is $1$.

The point on the graph whose $x$-coordinate is $1$ is the point $(1,-2)$.

**Therefore, $h(1)=-2$.**
